kind: source-only experimental controller contract; no implementation or experiment
identity: acquire-lift-transfer-v1; fresh identity, matched unchanged v16
reference_frame: A floating thorax with passive distal joints and position-actuated proximal joints in unilateral, frictional, adhesive contact. Native phase is motor intent; support and material velocity are physical state. A position command below the plane may be normal preload and is not an error. The proposed velocity-to-position feedback is a sampled impedance hypothesis, not an inverse-dynamics feasibility certificate.
root_cause: The old independent minimum-point correction ignores root/passive motion and other supports, while intent phase releases adhesion irrespective of acquired landing. Fixed diagnosis identifies missed LM acquisition, RM proximal slip before distal5 acquisition, and hind lift occurring after actual AP progress. One coordinated realization state machine plus bounded measured-motion feedback replaces that boundary.
minimality: No optimizer framework, predictive simulator, force estimator, neural retuning, new body, or new trajectory asset. Six 7x7 linear systems per active tick, one <=3x3 planar-twist least-squares system, and a 2-D convex hull suffice. Existing splines provide motor intent and per-cycle excursion. All legs share release admission and desired body twist; their Jacobian solves share those physical constraints.

measurements_and_ownership.clock: At action tick k read q[k],v[k]. Reconstruct geometry and Jacobians only from that state in a detached MjData workspace. The most recently completed native contact/force interval is k-1 -> k; its contact positions/frames/forces belong to q[k-1], not endpoint q[k]. Retain the prestate q[k-1],v[k-1] and reconstruct J there for its slip/force association. Do not use NativeRecorder's hybrid J(q[k-1])v[k] as feedback. Thus load/landing counters deliberately have one-interval latency.
measurements_and_ownership.contact_transport: Every prior-interval foot contact is owned by (foot geom, ground geom, contact index, interval tick). Map contact.pos to its foot body's local coordinate using the q[k-1] body transform; transport that material point into q[k] and evaluate its full Jacobian and velocity there. This is a one-tick material continuation, not a claim that the same point is currently loaded. Never transport the force to a newly selected mesh minimum. Reject rows outside the declared foot-ground map. All tarsus1..5 contacts including positive-margin and zero-force rows remain recorded; only finite Fn>0 contributes load/admission.
measurements_and_ownership.geometry: For every one of the 30 owned tarsus collision meshes evaluate all compiled vertices at q[k]. Select each mesh's exact minimum-z vertex; tie by vertex index. Five selected material points per leg establish the actual all-foot minimum without assuming tarsus5 is lowest. Tarsus5 centroid is the arithmetic mean of its compiled mesh vertices transformed into world coordinates. All per-contact rows are retained in feedback where specified; no peak-only contact selection.
measurements_and_ownership.frames_units: World plane z=0 in native millimetres, +z up. Thorax forward/lateral/up are columns of R. q and command angles rad, angular velocities rad/s, time seconds, Jacobians mm/rad on active hinges, forces native units without a Newton claim. COM is mass-weighted body xipos over the fly subtree; COM velocity is the corresponding mass-weighted mj_jacBodyCom @ qvel. Native gravity g=norm(model.opt.gravity) in mm/s^2. All contact tangent projections use that contact's normal, with arbitrary normal sign removed by I-n*n^T.
measurements_and_ownership.maps: Reuse foot_ids, controller.legs, dof_spec_to_jointdof, default output order, and AllocationSensor's actuator_trnid -> joint qpos/dof maps. Validate unit gear hinge transmissions, 42 unique position actuators, six adhesion actuators, unchanged gain45/force[-65,65], flat ground, positive g, all mass finite and positive, and unchanged model/asset/input hashes before a future trial. Root and all passive coordinates are measured inputs, never assigned commands.

fixed_parameters.parameter_provenance: 0.05 mm is the existing native lift setpoint; .02 mm and 30 ticks come from frozen physical gates; .003 s=30dt; .05 s=1/native magnitude convergence20; pi/2 equals twice native swing_extension pi/4; ratio2 permits bounded recovery of delay. The support margin and regularizer use the frozen .02-mm physical scale. These are fixed prospective engineering choices, not fitted or claimed optimal. No gain search follows a failure.

intent_and_realized_phase.intent: For finite nonnegative uL,uR, c=(uL+uR)/2<=.4 and a=(uR-uL)/(2c), |a|<=.8. Advance the unchanged native Euler CPG once per active dt: nu=12c/.6, w=w_base*c/.6, R_i=1-a on left and 1+a on right, dr_i/dt=20(R_i-r_i), dtheta_i/dt=2pi*nu_i+sum_j r_j*w_ij*sin(theta_j-theta_i-bias_ij). Save unwrapped theta and r. Do not call HybridController.step or advance a second CPG.
intent_and_realized_phase.realization: Separate unwrapped phi_i starts at reset theta_i. beta_i=swing_period[i][1]+pi/4, validated 0<beta_i<2pi. Proposed advance dphi=min(2*dtheta,theta_next-phi) with dtheta=theta_next-theta. Reject nonpositive dtheta or negative lag beyond numerical tolerance. Clip the advance at the next state boundary; unused advance is not spent in another state during the same tick. Consequently 0<=theta_next-phi_next<=pi/2, otherwise terminal phase_lag failure before action. Gate wait greater than 500 consecutive active ticks is terminal stall. No cycle skipping, phase reset or silent resynchronization.
intent_and_realized_phase.modes: SUPPORT occupies beta..2pi; RELEASE_WAIT holds at 2pi until admitted; LIFT occupies 0..beta/3; TRANSFER beta/3..2beta/3; LAND beta*2/3..beta. LIFT cannot pass beta/3 until the last30 completed intervals have exactly zero summed positive all-foot force and their endpoint all-foot minimum is strictly>.02mm. LAND cannot pass beta until last30 completed intervals have positive tarsus5 force. These distal counters are controller predicates only: accepted support still uses every original all-foot rule. Adhesion is OFF only during LIFT and TRANSFER, ON in LAND/SUPPORT/RELEASE_WAIT/REACQUIRE. Turning magnitudes remain native r; phi is explicitly changed phase realization.
intent_and_realized_phase.initialization: Keep native reset phases, zero magnitudes, RNG and neutral action. On first active observation initialize each leg's mode from its current phi interval, initialize its trajectory from current measured foot, and mark its first cycle partial. Acquire30-interval load history before any new release. No preactivation sensor/CPG updates during silence. At a release, save A0 and lateral coordinate in the current thorax frame, current world foot height, current magnitude and intended cycle index. Mid-cycle initialization uses the same rules with the local segment start at the initial phase and retains the partial label.
intent_and_realized_phase.loss_of_support: If a SUPPORT/RELEASE_WAIT leg has zero prior-interval all-foot positive force, enter REACQUIRE at its unchanged phi, save current distal world xy, hold phi and turn adhesion ON; no new releases while any leg is LAND or REACQUIRE. Reacquire distal30 before resuming that phi. Failure of this conservative rule to maintain cadence is a falsifier, not an excuse to delete cycles.
intent_and_realized_phase.release_admission: Using only acquired support legs with30 consecutive positive all-foot intervals and current adhesion ON, form hull of all their transported positive-force material points projected onto ground. Before each pending release remove that leg's points. Capture point xi=COM_xy+vCOM_xy*sqrt(max(COM_z,0)/g) must lie strictly inside the remaining convex hull eroded by .02mm, thorax up_z must be>.8, and no LAND/REACQUIRE may be pending. Hull with fewer than3 noncollinear distinct points fails. Examine waiting legs in decreasing unwrapped intent lag, ties fixed LF,LM,LH,RF,RM,RH; immediately remove each admitted leg before considering the next. Equal-priority legs are therefore never independently granted the same support. This is a conservative geometric/inertial admission heuristic and ignores adhesive tensile reserve; it does not certify support wrench or future reachability.

trajectory.native_excursion: At release only, in a detached workspace hold actual root and passive q fixed and evaluate the existing native spline at phase0 and phase swing_period[i][1], magnitude1, replacing only that leg's seven actuated hinges; apply compiled joint/control limits to those reference angles only. Two kinematics evaluations produce body-forward distal centroid coordinates A_native0,A_native1. Define L_i=r_i_at_release*abs(A_native1-A_native0) mm. No minimum excursion floor; zero or inadequate L may fail the original AP gate. Restore workspace from actual state before actual Jacobians. No simulated dynamics or target-driven body motion is used. This future per-release evaluation is part of controller design, not a call made during this design task.
trajectory.lift: AP target A=A0, lateral target Y=Y0. For all five mesh minima demand height .05mm. AP/lateral desired derivatives are zero in moving thorax coordinates. Height task is desired world vz=clip((.05-h_mesh)/.003,-.05/.003,.05/.003). LIFT may progress to beta/3 but holds there until clear-unloaded dwell is observed. No AP protraction is commanded before that dwell.
trajectory.transfer: s=(phi-beta/3)/(beta/3), clamped[0,1]. A=A0+L*(3s^2-2s^3); dA/dt=L*6s(1-s)*dphi/(dt*beta/3). Y=Y0. Keep allfive mesh height tasks at .05mm throughout. Once phi reaches2beta/3 save the ACTUAL distal world xy as the landing anchor. This prevents a touchdown correction from chasing a moving body-relative AP goal.
trajectory.landing: Distal centroid world xy velocity target=(saved_xy-actual_xy)/.003, componentwise clamped to +/-.05/.003 mm/s. Lowest tarsus5 material point gets world normal target -min(.05/.003,max(h5,0)/.003) until prior-interval distal load is positive, then zero normal target. Every prior positive-force contact of that leg, including proximal tarsus1..4, receives zero world tangential velocity tasks. No prohibition on negative joint-command-derived height or clipping of position preload. Acquiring distal load through passive articulation while damping proximal slip is a hypothesis; incompatibility appears as residual/saturation or stall. At LAND completion begin SUPPORT with the retained continuous command and adhesion ON, without a target reset.
trajectory.reacquire: Use LAND equations with saved current actual distal world xy, phi held, native angle reference fixed at entry phi but current magnitude still evolves. Existing support legs continue body stabilization. Any inability to regain support within the same finite wait/lag bounds fails.

shared_support_feedback.native_planar_intent: qN_i=P_i(phi_i,r_i) from the existing spline; qN_next uses proposed phi_next,r_next. qN references outside compiled joint/control intervals are rejected; the two temporary excursion references are explicitly clipped as stated above. Let zN_i=(qN_next-qN_i)/dt. On all transported positive-force contacts of currently SUPPORT legs, solve min_x sum_i mean_contacts ||A_j*x+Jactive_xy*zN_i+Jpassive_xy*vpassive||^2 for x=(Vx,Vy,ell*OmegaZ), A_j=[[1,0,-r_y/ell],[0,1,r_x/ell]], r=point-thorax_pos. ell=max(.05,sqrt(mean_j||r_xy||^2)) mm. Use SVD minimum-norm solution with rank tolerance64*eps*max(1,smax). With no support rows use x=0. This extracts a common planar body twist from native stance excursions and side asymmetry instead of setting a desired arena heading or speed.
shared_support_feedback.attitude_and_height: Store thorax height z0 at first active observation; never store desired world yaw or XY goal. Vdes=(Vx,Vy,clip((z0-z)/.05,-1,1)) mm/s. Omega_des=OmegaZ*ez + (up cross ez)/.05 rad/s, with its z component from the planar fit only. up and z are actual endpoint geometry. Thus native stance motion supplies translation/yaw while body height and roll/pitch are feedback tasks. Their outcome remains physically mediated by contacts.
shared_support_feedback.support_rows: For every transported positive-force contact point on a SUPPORT/RELEASE_WAIT leg, desired active contribution b_j=-Vdes-Omega_des cross r_j-Jpassive_j*vpassive-Pt_j*v_actual_j, where Pt=I-n*n^T. Jactive_j*z_i approximates b_j. This compensates passive motion, retains one shared moving-body reference, and damps actual tangential slip. It does not pretend that freebody velocity is zero or that base motion is actuated. Actual freebody motion contributes to v_actual in the damping term. Each leg's allcontact group is normalized by sqrt(number of contacts), so contact tessellation does not multiply that leg's gain. Zero-force contacts remain logged and do not supply support equations.

joint_feedback_and_bounds.task_rows: For LIFT/TRANSFER add five normal rows each divided by sqrt(5), plus one AP and one lateral row of the distal centroid. For each scalar coordinate f(q), use Jactive=df/dq_active and b=desired_fdot+(f_target-f)/.003 - (measured_fdot-Jactive*vactive), omitting the position term when desired_fdot already contains that exact height/landing position servo. AP/lateral measured derivative includes moving thorax translation/rotation. For LAND/REACQUIRE use two distal XY rows, one distal-minimum normal row, and all loaded-contact tangent rows divided by sqrt(max(1,contactcount)); tangent rows project onto the recorded two orthonormal tangents. SUPPORT rows are as above. Each independent scalar task has unit weight after group normalization. All full velocities use J(q[k])v[k], including root/passives.
joint_feedback_and_bounds.solve: For each leg stack its rows A,b and solve the unique7x7 positive-definite system z=(A^T A+lambda^2 I)^-1*(A^T b+lambda^2 zN), lambda=.02mm/rad. z is rad/s. Empty A gives z=zN. Cholesky with fixed index order, float64, single numerical thread; nonfinite or failed factorization is terminal before mutation. No native retraction/stumbling correction is added a second time: this boundary REPLACES those applied angle offsets; their prior scalar state may be retained frozen only for provenance, never used covertly.
joint_feedback_and_bounds.increment: Let x_i=previous_applied_command_i-previous_native_reference_i. Native correction-vector norm C_i=||_CORRECTION_VECTORS[type]||2, with right sign convention applied once. e=dt*(z-zN), e'=e*min(1,(800*dt*C_i)/||e||), zero vector unchanged. x'=ProjEuclideanBall(radius80*C_i)(x_i+e'). Proposed command=clip_each(qN_next+x', compiled_lower,compiled_upper). Save actual xnext=command-qN_next. References in bounds imply ||xnext||<=80*C_i. Projection/clip continuity gives ||command_next-command_old||<=||qN_next-qN_old||+800dt*C_i. Total angle bounds are intersection of enabled model.jnt_range and actuator_ctrlrange. Gain45, native actuator force65 and adhesion gain40 stay unchanged. These explicitly REPLACE the old correction's phase-dependent norm and rise/fall schedules with a uniform per-leg ball and explicit incremental norm cap; they do not claim the v16 budget is unchanged. No force saturation is inferred from reaching the correction ball.
joint_feedback_and_bounds.residuals: Record A*z-b, actual achieved coordinate velocities, corrections before/after each projection, native-reference delta, active range flags, forcecap observations, all-foot height/load, phases/lags/modes and all support/landing predicates. Feedback infeasibility is not silently solved by increasing gain, budget or changing gates. A residual alone need not abort: the fixed finite state deadlines and unchanged physical gates determine failure. Invalid state, numerical failure, exceeded wait/lag, or unsafe original bound aborts with preserved partial evidence.

ordering_atomicity_silence.sequence: Validate drives first. For c<=1e-4 return exact copies of last angles/adhesion and do not run sensor, CPG, mode, counters, RNG, diagnostics or target calculations. Physical simulation continues under held ctrl exactly as original stop protocol. Otherwise validate version/model/tick/maps and construct coherent current/prior interval observation. In a deep private shadow: update histories from completed interval; advance intent CPG once; determine transitions/releases using OLD contact state and proposed phase limits; calculate proposed native references and per-cycle trajectory state; form shared body twist; solve allsix joint laws; project bounds; validate complete finite proposed state/action and all lag/deadline bounds; then commit controller/sensor shadow atomically and apply one LocomotionAction. Only then does authoritative physics advance once. No partial leg action is applied if another leg fails. Native contact caches are not refreshed by mj_forward on authoritative data before action.
ordering_atomicity_silence.failure: Malformed observation/stale tick/model mismatch/nonfinite or numerical action fails before commit, with last command/state intact and no physics step. Finite physical gate/stall failure is retained as a failed partial trial; stop according to original unsafe/cap policy and do not infer readiness from stopping early. No fallback switches back to v16 mid-trial. Trial-level recorder failure stops before another trial. A controller deadline failure ends that trial with its missing remainder explicitly failed/incomplete; it is never excluded from denominators. Continue the remaining fixed development conditions unless the original unsafe/resource/retention stop policy blocks them. Ordinary acceptance-metric failure alone does not authorize early termination of an otherwise safe run.
ordering_atomicity_silence.checkpoint: Versioned complete controller __dict__ plus explicit immutable binding: native CPG theta/r/config/base arrays/RNG, realizedphi/modes/boundary indices, perleg clear/load/distal interval counters and500tick wait counters, cycle IDs/partial flags, AP/lateral/release-magnitude/L/landingxy/z0, previous native reference/applied angles/adhesion/x, previous q/v and transforms needed for interval ownership, last interval contact rows/forces/identity and endpoint heights, last tick/model hash/maps/ranges, all diagnostic/residual/projection state, and sensor detached state/caches if reused. Full authoritative mj_copyData cache, integration state, body tick/drives, observation and recorder state are restored together. Restore validates exact schema, arrays, dtypes/shapes/finiteness, hashes and disjoint ownership into a shadow before atomic bind. No warm solver state exists. Bitwise continuation must be independently tested later.

prospective_panel_and_falsifiers.candidate: One registered candidate acquire-lift-transfer-v1 against newly run unchanged v16 under identical seeds/inputs/model. No tuning branches or alternative candidates.32x4s development=128s; only after full unchanged development passes: heldout64s, repeat4s, restore.01s, total196.01s;260s hard. Original259s neural/product plan remains unchanged and separately gated by independent mechanics review.
mechanistic_predictions: RM early-stance .138/.320mm pre-distal slip should decrease because landing brakes all proximal material tangents while distal approach and adhesion persist; if distal acquisition improves but full-stance slip remains>=.15mm, the law fails.

LM missed support should delay outgoing release and invoke reacquisition while shared stance feedback controls body attitude; if delay merely causes stall/lag or overturn, the proposed support admission/feedback is insufficient.

LH/RH lift should occur before AP transfer and yield>=30 unloaded clear intervals between independently measured PEP/AEP. If native-angle preferences, passive tarsi or target bounds defeat lift, or actual AP still has no later maximum, the law fails despite the phase labels.

Native magnitude asymmetry and extracted support twist should preserve straight/yaw/turn/dose semantics. Any reversal, speed/dose regression or failure of original turn/stop gates rejects this candidate even if slip improves.

Per-leg phase holds must remain withinpi/2 and50ms, and realized cycles must not disappear through timeout, partial labeling or reduced cadence. Conservative hull false negatives, phase accumulation, bootstrap support loss, passive-contact rank conflict, body-height reference error and touchdown bounce are explicit failure cases.
Bitwise silence and checkpoint restoration must remain exact; floating contact history reconstruction and fresh observation adapter are specifically tested for off-by-one errors.
prospective_panel_and_falsifiers.acceptance_unchanged: All original all-foot/all-leg AP definitions, centered31-sample median, extrema ties/reversals/inconclusives/partials, unloaded>=30 intervals at height>.02mm, support>=30 intervals, full-stance slip<.15mm, upright/yaw/turn/stop/dose remain. Evaluate complete cycles separately against BOTH unchanged intent-phase windows and declared realized-phase windows; candidate must pass original intent-window criteria as well, so phase gating cannot redefine away a failure. Any failure or inconclusive blocks heldout and downstream admission. Distal5 and capture-point predicates never substitute for all-foot evidence.
prospective_panel_and_falsifiers.uncertainty: No efficacy, dynamic feasibility, accepted walking, neural phenotype, UI,4060, Chrono/trureturing or original user-goal completion is claimed. The smallest design structure is closed enough to implement as one falsifiable candidate after independent selection; proof of success is deliberately left to its prospective experiment.
